Place the pinned clap-helpers repo from free-audio here.

https://github.com/free-audio/clap-helpers

This folder (CLAP_HELPERS) should be the root of the repo at
55a5dd5d1db9c87b32f407e387f64676d27e10b1.

For a non-destructive fetch into a separate empty directory, run
IPLUG_CLAP_DEPS_DIR=/path/to/deps ./download-clap-layout-sdks.sh from this directory.
